item.title: Judge IV (Examiner Designs): Causal Inference via Random Assignment
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: An introduction to an emerging instrumental variable, judge IV. Its strength is that it can further test random assignment, monotonicity, and the exclusion restriction of the instrument.

item.title: Pensions and Fertility
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: Notes on the AER paper ‘Pensions and Fertility: Microeconomic Evidence’. It uses microdata to study the relationship between pensions and fertility. Expanding pension coverage lowers fertility.

item.title: Econometrics: Is the log(y+1) transformation reliable?

item.description: Reading notes on ‘Logs with Zeros? Some Problems and Solutions’. When the variable being transformed includes zeros, the log(y+1) transformation has some limits in treatment-effect estimation.
